title: Week 3 review — databases, DR, migration, hybrid networking
topic: Full Week 3 recap: RDS/Aurora, Lambda→Aurora lab, DynamoDB PITR/Streams, DR/RTO/RPO/AWS Backup, DMS/migration, VPN/DX/TGW/PrivateLink, 3-tier VPC architecture
format: 30 timed scenario questions (~48 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-22-week-3-review.md and Nights 15–21. No new lab deploy. Answer without peeking at night-22-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×8 B×7 C×8 D×7 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: You are sketching GSA's exam architecture on paper. Users browse the wiki over HTTPS. An ALB terminates TLS and forwards to Fargate tasks. Aurora holds resort_stats in private subnets. Where should the ALB sit relative to the NAT Gateway?

options.A: ALB in public subnets with route to IGW; Fargate and Aurora in private subnets
options.B: ALB and Aurora in public subnets; only Fargate stays private for this workload
options.C: ALB in private subnets only — NAT Gateway replaces the need for public subnets
options.D: ALB attached directly to the Aurora writer endpoint on port 5432 for this workload

questions.question: Night 17 Lambda saa-study-gsa-stats-uploader times out on first invoke but succeeds on the second. Aurora security groups are correct. Most likely cause?

options.B: Cold-start ENI attachment in the VPC before outbound TCP to Aurora completes
options.A: Lambda must use the Aurora reader endpoint for UPSERT operations for this workload
options.C: SQS FIFO queue is required for any Lambda in a VPC for this workload
options.D: Secrets Manager blocks all connections until Multi-AZ failover finishes

questions.question: Leadership asks for automatic Aurora writer failover in the same Region with minimal write loss. BI dashboards must not hit the standby during normal operations. Best pattern?

options.C: Aurora cluster Multi-AZ with synchronous storage failover to a standby
options.A: Point all SELECT queries at the synchronous Multi-AZ standby endpoint
options.B: Single-AZ Aurora with weekly manual snapshots only for this workload
options.D: Three cross-Region read replicas with Route 53 weighted routing to all writers

questions.question: A wiki counter table needs restore to any second within the last month after a bad script. The original table must remain untouched for comparison. Which DynamoDB feature?

options.D: PITR — restore to a new table at a chosen timestamp within 35 days
options.A: On-demand backup that overwrites the existing table in place for this workload
options.B: AWS Backup vault lock that replays CloudTrail PutItem events for this workload
options.C: DynamoDB Streams with TRIM_HORIZON that rewinds the live table

questions.question: After a Region-wide outage, executives accept four hours to rebuild infrastructure from recovery points stored in a DR Region. Lowest-cost DR tier?

options.A: Backup and restore — AWS Backup recovery points plus IaC redeploy
options.B: Multi-site active-active with DynamoDB global tables in every Region
options.C: Warm standby with min=2 Auto Scaling in the DR Region at all times
options.D: Aurora Global Database with active writes in both Regions 24×7

questions.question: On-prem resort_stats PostgreSQL must replicate ongoing INSERTs to Aurora in saa-study-gsa-vpc while production stays on-prem until cutover. Which DMS task type?

options.B: Full load plus CDC — initial copy then tail the source WAL/binlog
options.A: Full load only — one-time table scan with no transaction log tailing
options.C: CDC only — assumes the target already has every historical row
options.D: DynamoDB export to S3 — streams live writes to Parquet automatically

questions.question: Resort HQ (192.168.0.0/16) needs encrypted connectivity to the Night 9 VPC (10.0.0.0/16) within days. No dedicated fiber yet. Fastest AWS option?

options.A: VPC peering between the on-premises LAN and the VPC CIDR blocks
options.B: AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint installed in the on-prem rack
options.C: AWS Site-to-Site VPN — IPSec tunnels to a virtual private gateway or TGW
options.D: Direct Connect 10 Gbps port provisioned this afternoon for hybrid use for this workload

questions.question: Night 18 stream Lambda should log both the old and new viewCount on every MODIFY. Which DynamoDB stream view type?

options.D: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES — both versions of the item in each stream record
options.A: KEYS_ONLY — partition and sort keys without attribute values for this workload
options.B: NEW_IMAGE only — previous attribute values are never included for this workload
options.C: OLD_IMAGE only — post-change state is omitted from each record for this workload

questions.question: Fargate tasks in private subnets must read wiki assets from S3 without paying NAT data-processing charges for that traffic. Night 8/10 pattern?

options.A: S3 Gateway VPC endpoint associated with the private route table
options.B: PrivateLink interface endpoint to a third-party S3-compatible vendor
options.C: Internet Gateway attached to the private subnet route table
options.D: NAT Gateway with S3 prefix lists disabled for cost savings

questions.question: 500 concurrent Lambdas each open a new MySQL connection to RDS at peak. Secrets Manager is already in use. Minimal-change fix from Night 15 theory?

options.B: Deploy RDS Proxy — pool connections; Lambdas target the proxy endpoint
options.A: Enable Multi-AZ — doubles the connection limit on the standby for this workload
options.C: Switch all relational tables to DynamoDB with GSIs for JOINs for this workload
options.D: Use Aurora Backtrack on PostgreSQL to rewind connection storms for this workload

questions.question: Dev, Staging, and Logging VPCs must all reach each other and on-prem. Full mesh VPC peering is rejected. Hub design?

options.C: Transit Gateway with attachments per VPC and centralized route tables
options.A: One Site-to-Site VPN per VPC without a shared gateway for this workload
options.B: PrivateLink interface endpoint in every spoke for every resource
options.D: Inter-Region VPC peering only — no hybrid connectivity for this workload

questions.question: night-19-lab tags saa-study-gsa-wiki-views with saa-study-backup=night-19. A new study table gets the same tag tomorrow. What happens?

options.D: The new table auto-enrolls in the backup plan without editing the selection
options.A: AWS Backup disables DynamoDB PITR on all tagged tables for this workload
options.B: Tags are cosmetic — only ARNs listed in the plan can be backed up for this workload
options.C: The vault name must exactly match the tag value or jobs fail for this workload

questions.question: A vendor SaaS API runs in another AWS account. GSA consumers need private access without merging VPC route tables or peering entire CIDRs. Best fit?

options.A: AWS PrivateLink — consumer interface endpoint to the provider NLB service
options.B: VPC peering between GSA and vendor VPCs merging entire CIDR tables
options.C: S3 Gateway endpoint in the consumer VPC for SaaS API private access
options.D: Public internet with IP allow lists on the vendor Application Load Balancer

questions.question: Night 20 lab exports saa-study-gsa-wiki-views to S3 for Athena staging. A teammate calls this live CDC replication. Correct?

options.B: No — export is a point-in-time snapshot to S3; ongoing changes need DMS or Streams
options.A: Yes — export streams every PutItem to S3 in real time like DMS for this workload for this workload
options.C: Yes — export and DMS CDC are identical for DynamoDB sources for this workload
options.D: Partially — export is CDC if PITR is enabled on the table for this workload

questions.question: Direct Connect is the primary hybrid link. Leadership wants resilience when the DX circuit fails. Standard companion?

options.C: Site-to-Site VPN as backup terminating on the same Transit Gateway or VGW
options.A: Second Internet Gateway in the VPC for automatic failover for this workload
options.B: Replace private VIF with public VIF only during outages for this workload
options.D: VPC peering to a second Direct Connect location in another Region for this workload

questions.question: GSA needs sub-second cross-Region RPO on Aurora PostgreSQL with a managed global topology. Which feature?

options.D: Aurora Global Database — primary and secondary Region with low replication lag
options.A: RDS automated backup copy every five minutes as live replication for this workload
options.B: Promote a cross-Region read replica after manual health check for this workload
options.C: RDS Multi-AZ synchronous standby in the same Region only for this workload

questions.question: VPC A peers with VPC B. VPC B peers with VPC C. Can VPC A reach VPC C through VPC B?

options.A: No — VPC peering is non-transitive; need A↔C peering or Transit Gateway
options.B: Yes — peering is transitive across unlimited hops for this workload
options.C: Yes — if all three VPCs share the same /16 CIDR block for this workload
options.D: Only if an Internet Gateway is attached to VPC B as a hub for this workload

questions.question: Night 16 Aurora sits in Night 9 private subnets. Which ingress rule belongs on aurora-sg for the stats Lambda?

options.B: Allow TCP 5432 from the Lambda security group ID as source
options.A: Allow TCP 5432 from 0.0.0.0/0 — Lambda has no fixed IP
options.C: Allow all traffic from the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 for this workload
options.D: No inbound — Aurora initiates connections to Lambda on 5432

questions.question: Terabytes of on-prem file shares must seed S3 before a narrow maintenance window. No sustained 10 Gbps link. Offline bulk transfer?

options.C: AWS Snowball Edge device — ship drives, import into S3
options.A: AWS DataSync agent over a 1 Mbps VPN for this workload
options.B: DMS full load plus CDC from NFS mount points for this workload
options.D: DynamoDB export to S3 with PITR enabled for this workload

questions.question: Compare warm standby and pilot light for the same RPO. Which statement is accurate?

options.D: Warm standby keeps a scaled-down live DR stack — typically lower RTO than
options.A: Pilot light runs full production ASG capacity in DR at all times for this workload
options.B: Warm standby never runs database instances until failover for this workload
options.C: Both have identical RTO because neither uses Route 53 health checks for this workload

questions.question: Oracle on-prem must land on Aurora PostgreSQL with schema conversion before DMS cutover. Which AWS tool?

options.A: AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT) — heterogeneous assessment and conversion
options.B: AWS DataSync — converts PL/SQL packages during file sync for this workload
options.C: Snowball Edge — runs Oracle inside the appliance for conversion for this workload
options.D: RDS Proxy — translates Oracle wire protocol to PostgreSQL for this workload

questions.question: On-prem and the VPC both use 10.0.0.0/16. Site-to-Site VPN tunnels are up but routes never work. Root cause?

options.B: Overlapping CIDR blocks — hybrid routing cannot disambiguate addresses
options.A: VPN requires Direct Connect before BGP sessions establish for this workload
options.C: Virtual private gateway only supports /8 networks for this workload
options.D: Client VPN must be enabled before Site-to-Site VPN routes propagate

questions.question: Night 13 SQS visibility timeout is 60 seconds. Night 17 Lambda timeout is 30 seconds. Why is this pairing valid?

options.C: Visibility timeout ≥ Lambda timeout — message stays hidden while Lambda runs
options.A: Visibility timeout must equal Lambda timeout exactly for this workload
options.B: Lambda timeout must exceed visibility timeout to prevent duplicate processing
options.D: Visibility timeout should be at least six times the Lambda timeout for this workload

questions.question: Compliance auditor asks whether CloudTrail replaces AWS Backup for wiki tables. Accurate response?

options.D: No — CloudTrail records API activity; it is not a backup and restore service
options.A: Yes — CloudTrail stores full table snapshots in the trail S3 bucket for this workload
options.B: Yes — enabling data events on DynamoDB equals PITR plus AWS Backup for this workload
options.C: Partially — CloudTrail replaces backup when S3 Object Lock is enabled for this workload

questions.question: Aurora Serverless v2 dev cluster should eliminate overnight idle cost by scaling to zero ACUs like Serverless v1. Accurate for v2?

options.A: No — v2 maintains a configurable minimum ACU; tear down dev stacks when idle
options.B: Yes — v2 pauses after ten minutes without connections for this workload for this workload
options.C: Yes — but only for Aurora MySQL, not PostgreSQL Serverless v2 clusters
options.D: Only when RDS Proxy holds open connections overnight for this workload

questions.question: Direct Connect private VIF carries production ETL to Aurora. Security asks whether DX encrypts traffic by default. Correct?

options.B: No — dedicated circuit is private, not encrypted; add VPN over DX if required
options.A: Yes — AES-256 on every private VIF automatically without extra config
options.C: Yes — but only when Transit Gateway is the attachment target for this workload
options.D: No — DX only supports unencrypted public VIF; private VIF requires VPN for this workload

questions.question: GSA wiki page views need unpredictable scale with simple ADD increments. resort_stats needs SQL JOINs for BI. Store pairing?

options.C: DynamoDB for page-view counters; Aurora for relational stats and reports
options.A: Aurora for both — one cluster simplifies operations for this workload
options.B: DynamoDB for both — model JOINs as multiple GetItem calls for this workload
options.D: S3 Iceberg only — eliminate databases for both workloads for this workload

questions.question: Before cutover, DMS shows replication lag dropping after writes stop to the on-prem source. What are you waiting for?

options.D: Lag ≈ 0 so the target matches the source before DNS points to Aurora
options.A: Lag to exceed 24 hours so full load runs again automatically for this workload
options.B: SCT to reconvert the schema after every committed transaction for this workload
options.C: Snowball return shipment confirmation from the DR Region for this workload

questions.question: Remote engineers need individual laptop access to resources in saa-study-gsa-vpc from hotels. Whole data center already has Site-to-Site VPN. Add-on service?

options.A: AWS Client VPN — per-user OpenVPN/WireGuard into the VPC
options.B: Another Site-to-Site VPN tunnel per laptop public IP
options.C: VPC peering from the laptop to the VPC for this workload
options.D: Direct Connect from each hotel broadband circuit for this workload

questions.question: You finished Week 3 database labs and want to stop Aurora charges but keep Night 9 VPC for Week 4 ElastiCache. Correct teardown order?

options.C: Night 17 Lambda teardown, then Night 16 Aurora teardown — keep Night 9 VPC
options.A: Delete VPC first — Aurora auto-deletes with the subnet group for this workload
options.B: Night 16 Aurora first while Lambda is still connected — fastest cleanup
options.D: Delete NAT Gateway only — Aurora Serverless v2 scales to zero automatically
